messages:
maya_acme: Hey support — hitting a weird tool routing issue. Our app calls the Redwood API to do a KB lookup but the response is failing schema validation. The API response shows it routed to 'kb_search' (legacy) instead of our newer 'kb_lookup_v2'. Payload missing required `doc_id` param so downstream throws. Happening intermittently since ~07:12 UTC. Example response attached below.

alex_support: Sorry about that — can you paste the exact request you used and the full response body? Also which model/endpoint?

maya_acme: Using hosted generate endpoint, model:redwood-mini-3b, endpoint: POST /v1/generate. Repro curl below.

maya_acme: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate \\n  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_..." \\n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\n  -d '{"input":"Find docs about payment flow","tool_call":{"name":"kb_lookup_v2","arguments":{"query":"payment flow"}},"max_tokens":128}'
```

maya_acme: Response we get (truncated):
```json
{
  "id":"resp_01",
  "tool_choice":"kb_search",
  "tool_call":{
    "name":"kb_search",
    "arguments":{
      "q":"payment flow"
    }
  },
  "error":{
    "type":"schema_validation_error",
    "message":"kb_search schema accepted but downstream expects different fields (doc_id missing)"
  }
}
```

alex_support: Hmm — looks like the model asked for kb_lookup_v2 but the router matched an alias and routed to kb_search. Can you confirm your account has both tools registered? Any recent changes to tool manifest?

maya_acme: Yes we onboarded kb_lookup_v2 last week and kept the old kb_search until we finish migration. Tool manifests (customer-side) have both: names are pretty similar which I suspect is the cause.

ryan_eng: Looping in eng-runtime. From the router logs we saw earlier, the routing component uses fuzzy alias matching for historical names to preserve compatibility. That heuristic can pick the wrong candidate when function signatures overlap.

ryan_eng: Quick snapshot from router debug log (sanitized):
```text
[2026-03-10T07:12:34Z] request_id=abc123 candidate_scores=[{"tool":"kb_lookup_v2","score":0.72},{"tool":"kb_search","score":0.70}] selected=kb_search reason="alias_match + legacy_priority"
```

alex_support: That explains the intermittent nature — when scores are close it falls back to legacy_priority. We should provide a repro for eng to test and a temporary customer mitigation.

maya_acme: Mitigation request — can we force the generate call to pick kb_lookup_v2? For now we can toggle off kb_search in our account but would prefer a less disruptive option.

sophie_oncall: Temporary workaround: include an explicit tool hint in the prompt or set "tool_routing": {"preferred_tools":["kb_lookup_v2"]} to force an ordered preference. Example: "tool_routing": {"preferred_tools":["kb_lookup_v2"]} in the request body. That should bypass fuzzy fallback.

alex_support: Also accepting a short repro we can attach to the incident. Maya — can you run this adjusted curl (adds preferred_tools) and confirm response?

maya_acme: Running now... confirmed — with preferred_tools set the router selects kb_lookup_v2 consistently. Response shows tool_call.name="kb_lookup_v2" and returned docs. Temporary fix works.

ryan_eng: Engineering action items: 1) treat as bug — fuzzy alias + legacy_priority yields wrong selection when signature overlap, 2) add stricter exact-id match option in router config, 3) add a debug flag to return the selected routing signal to callers for faster diagnostics. Creating dev ticket.

ryan_eng: PR planned: router: enforce exact-id when caller provides tool_call.name or preferred_tools, fallback only when explicit name absent. Target branch: eng/runtime/hardening/kb-tool-match.

alex_support: Logged internal incident INC-3421 and linked customer repro. Provided Maya the temporary workaround and ETA for eng patch: 48-72h for dogfooding, then rollout.

maya_acme: Thanks — appreciate the quick workaround. Can you notify when patch is staged? We depend on kb_lookup_v2 for our payments path.

sophie_oncall: Will do. Also monitoring for any other customers with similar tool name collisions and will add a detection rule to flag close-score tie cases.

deploy-bot: Deployed feature-flag toggle for strict_tool_name_match on canary hosts (canary-region-2) at 2026-03-10T08:20:00Z :rocket:

ryan_eng: After canary validation, we'll roll out strict matching behind a control-plane toggle. Long term: recommend customers use unique tool ids (avoid overlapping aliases) and encourage explicit preferred_tools in requests during migration.

alex_support: Closing loop for now — marked customer as notified. Keeping INC-3421 open until rollout. If you see recurrence after we push the toggle let us know and we'll escalate urgently. :thumbsup:
